searchText: <@!144468805697929216> submitted an existing proposal very similar to this one, you can see the full discussion around that here: https://ethresear.ch/t/simple-transfers-of-excess-balance/8263 I'm aware of <@144468805697929216> 's proposal but they are different on many ways. His proposal is really about transfers, this one is about simply changing the recipient of earnings so there's no need to keep track of a transaction between validators.
